94: // startedAttributes returns the semantic-convention attributes describing a
95: // started command event, deciding each attribute's key in one place.
96: func (m *monitor) startedAttributes(evt *event.CommandStartedEvent) []attribute.KeyValue {
97: 	hostname, port := peerInfo(evt)
98: 
99: 	attrs := []attribute.KeyValue{semconv.DBSystemMongoDB}
100: 	attrs = appendOpNameAttrs(attrs, evt.CommandName)
101: 	attrs = appendDBNamespace(attrs, evt.DatabaseName)
102: 	attrs = appendNetworkPort(attrs, port)
103: 	attrs = appendNetworkHost(attrs, hostname)
104: 	attrs = appendNetworkAddress(attrs, net.JoinHostPort(hostname, strconv.Itoa(port)))
105: 	attrs = appendNetworkTransport(attrs)
106: 	return attrs
107: }
